name: Ador Welding Ltd
title: Ador Welding Ltd - 517041 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Ador guides no numbers; capex ~INR30-35cr for FY27 mostly consumable lines, utilisation ~70% blended but some lines at 90-95%, and management targets ~100-200bps EBITDA margin gain over coming periods.

utilisation.quote: I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

capex.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

triggers.label: FY27 capex INR30-35cr, consumable lines
triggers.quote: Our capex is generally in the region of approximately INR30 crores-INR35 crores for the coming year.

triggers.label: Blended utilisation ~70%
triggers.quote: I would say a fair estimate is anywhere in the region of approximately 70%.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin +100-200bps over coming periods
triggers.quote: you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.

triggers.label: Flares/process division folded into welding
triggers.quote: We no longer have a division called Flares and Process Equipment.

guidance.quote: you can see that happen, for another 100, 200 basis points going forward over the coming periods.
we expect INR30 crores- INR35 crores, even it could stretch it out to INR40 maybe at the most over the next two years, each year.
we are planning that those numbers should be in that line of what I mentioned at the very minimum.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Revenue target INR2,000 crore by FY29
prior_guidance_check.quote: we are still following the principle of doing that

red_flags.label: Management declines explicit guidance and revenue split
red_flags.quote: we don't give the revenue numbers for specific reasons

red_flags.label: Income tax demand ~INR14cr under appeal
red_flags.quote: we have filed our appeal last week only and we don't see any merit

red_flags.label: BIS matter pending in magistrate court
red_flags.quote: it still got to go back to magistrate court, which we have been given a date sometime in June-July.

evasions.quote: We don't share too much of that data externally.
I won't give you a revenue number because that is slightly confidential
I don't share it publicly. We don't like to give guidance
